summary: Changing a declaration associated with a CSS rule invalidates/recomputes affected style rather than only mutating a detached map.

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

semantics.invalidation: affected elements must be restyled as needed
semantics.layout: layout invalidation depends on changed property

tests.name: normal
tests.expected_behavior: elements matched by the rule can observe new computed color

tests.name: edge
tests.expected_behavior: layout-affecting declaration may require layout invalidation, not just repaint
